basic_details.job_title: ICAR CIBA Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 4 Young Professional, Field Assistant Posts
basic_details.short_information: ICAR-Central Institute of Brackishwater Aquaculture (ICAR-CIBA), Chennai, has invited applications for four purely temporary project posts: two Young Professional-II, one Young Professional-I and one Field Assistant. The posts are under the NFDB-funded project "Super-Intensive Precision and Natural Shrimp Farming (SIPNSF): Upscaling and Demonstration for Commercial Adoptions", for one year initially, with consolidated pay of ₹42,000, ₹30,000 and ₹22,000 / ₹18,000 per month. content_sections.heading: About the Institute and Project
content_sections.text: The notice is issued by ICAR-CIBA on its letterhead, and the interview is to be held at ICAR-CIBA, Chennai. The posts serve the SIPNSF project, funded by the National Fisheries Development Board (NFDB), Hyderabad. The work is at shrimp farms in Muttukadu (Chennai, Tamil Nadu) and Moolapalem (Srikakulam, Andhra Pradesh).

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The notice lists four posts in total. A category-wise break-up is not printed.

rows.place_of_post: Muttukadu, Chennai, Tamil Nadu (1 post); Moolapalem, Srikakulam, Andhra Pradesh (1 post)

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Prior experience in shrimp farming for a minimum of 2 years, preferably in intensive or modern shrimp farming systems. Practical knowledge of shrimp health monitoring, feeding management, water quality management and farm operations will be an added advantage. Should stay at the farm site and actively participate in day-to-day farm operations such as feeding, cast-net sampling and pond cleaning. Should be willing to dive in shrimp culture tanks/ponds and work in water whenever required for routine farm activities, monitoring and maintenance. Prior experience in aquaculture for a minimum of 1 year, preferably in intensive or modern shrimp farming systems. Should stay at the farm site and actively participate in day-to-day farm operations such as feeding, cast-net sampling and pond cleaning. Should be willing to dive in shrimp culture tanks/ponds and work in water whenever required for routine farm activities, monitoring and maintenance. Prior experience in aquaculture or any farming. Should reside locally or stay at the farm site and actively participate in day-to-day farm operations such as feeding, cast-net sampling and pond cleaning. Should be willing to dive in shrimp culture tanks/ponds and work in water whenever required for routine farm activities, monitoring and maintenance. The notice gives one limit for all three posts: lower age limit 21 years and upper age limit 45 years, with age relaxation for SC/ST/OBC candidates as per Govt. of India norms. The notice prints no date as on which age is counted. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

rows.essential_qualification: Postgraduate Degree (M.F.Sc. / M.Tech. /M.Sc.) in Professional Fisheries Science/Aquaculture/Aquaculture Engineering/Marine Biology/Zoology/Coastal Aquaculture.
Undergraduate Degree (B.F.Sc./ B.Tech. / B.Sc.) in Professional Fisheries Science/Aquaculture/Marine Biology/Zoology/Coastal Aquaculture or Graduate in Aquaculture Engineering.
Graduate in any stream/Diploma or Higher Secondary (10+2) qualification with relevant practical field-level experience in shrimp farming.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The emoluments are consolidated and stated per month: Young Professional-II ₹42,000, Young Professional-I ₹30,000, and Field Assistant ₹22,000 (Graduate/Diploma) or ₹18,000 (Higher Secondary 10+2). The notice mentions no HRA or other allowance. The posts are filled on a purely temporary basis in the institute. The duration is one year initially and may be extended based on satisfactory performance.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for ICAR-CIBA Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Download the application form (the prescribed proforma attached to the notice) and type it clearly. Applications are accepted in this proforma only. In the form, clearly indicate experience and skills/instruments used, and give contact numbers. Attach the duly filled and signed form with all required documents (degree certificates, experience certificates, research papers DOI, etc.). Name the PDF as SIPNSF_NFDB << Applicant First Name >>29112026.pdf. Attach/upload the PDF to the application available on https://ciba.res.in/recruitment/ on or before 29.11.2026. Failing to attach the required documents may lead to rejection of the application. NOC if employed in State/Central Govt., Autonomous Body or PSU. Post applied, name, date of birth and age, sex, marital status, category, father/husband name, correspondence address, phone and e-mail. Qualification table (post-graduation, graduation/diploma, higher secondary, SSLC or equivalent, others) with subject, institution, year of passing and % of marks/CGPA. Whether NET/GATE qualified, research papers in SCI/peer reviewed journals, patents, awards, working experience and whether currently employed. Work experience in project/industry/aquaculture, thesis/dissertation title and an abstract (max 150 words). Name and address of two referees with phone number and e-mail ID, and a statement of purpose in a maximum of one page. A signed declaration with date and place.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Communication will be sent only to shortlisted candidates. The date and time of the interview will be intimated to the shortlisted candidate by mail. The mode of interview is physical mode or a suitable online platform. Candidates who have received the mail should appear for an online/offline interview at ICAR-CIBA, Chennai, with the required documents. ICAR-CIBA does not enter into correspondence with applicants who are not called for an interview. The Director, CIBA reserves the right to accept or reject any applications. The notice does not describe marking or any other selection stage.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in ICAR-CIBA Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 4 posts: 2 Young Professional-II, 1 Young Professional-I and 1 Field Assistant.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date for submission of biodata is 29 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for Young Professional-II?
faq.answer: A postgraduate degree (M.F.Sc. / M.Tech. /M.Sc.) in Professional Fisheries Science/Aquaculture/Aquaculture Engineering/Marine Biology/Zoology/Coastal Aquaculture. Young Professional-I needs an undergraduate degree (B.F.Sc./ B.Tech. / B.Sc.) in a listed discipline or graduation in Aquaculture Engineering.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for Field Assistant?
faq.answer: Graduate in any stream/Diploma or Higher Secondary (10+2) qualification with relevant practical field-level experience in shrimp farming.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The lower age limit is 21 years and the upper age limit is 45 years, with relaxation for SC/ST/OBC candidates as per Govt. of India norms.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for each post?
faq.answer: Consolidated per month: Young Professional-II ₹42,000, Young Professional-I ₹30,000, Field Assistant ₹22,000 (Graduate/Diploma) or ₹18,000 (Higher Secondary 10+2).

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for ICAR-CIBA Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill the prescribed proforma, merge it with scanned certificates into one PDF and attach it to the application on https://ciba.res.in/recruitment/ on or before 29.11.2026.

faq.question: Q8. How is the interview conducted?
faq.answer: Shortlisted candidates are informed of the date and time by mail. The mode is physical or a suitable online platform, at ICAR-CIBA, Chennai.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. The posts are purely temporary, for one year initially, and may be extended based on satisfactory performance.

faq.answer: At shrimp farms in Muttukadu, Chennai, Tamil Nadu, and Moolapalem, Srikakulam, Andhra Pradesh; one Young Professional-II post is at Moolapalem.
